title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement:
The area of this figure is \(100 \text{ cm}^2.\) Its perimeter is

(The figure consists of four identical squares.)

solutions.text:
Each of the four squares has area \(\dfrac{100}{4} = 25 \text{ cm}^2\), so each side is \(5 \text{ cm}.\)

The outline of this staircase shape is made up of \(10\) such sides, so the perimeter is \(10 \cdot 5 = 50 \text{ cm}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
